trango-rock-prodigy-natural.supersedesBatch05Audit: docs/source-audits/2026-09-20-hangboards-batch-05-migration/native/trango-rock-prodigy-natural/geometry-verification.json (modelSHA256 b2bdbd9b...) is preserved unmodified as historical record of the retired GLB-import pipeline; Tools/HangboardPackages/tests/test_trango_batch05_model_migration.py no longer parametrizes 'natural'
trango-rock-prodigy-natural.shapeRevision: mesh-derived, regular holds authored as clean primitives: the two variable rails and the center-lower pocket use a stadium outline and the outer-supported-pocket an ellipse, built from the measured opening bounds (bounds taken from the front-plane rim, not the prim's full wall extent). This is a deliberate, labeled visual adaptation for form fidelity, not a traced measurement; rail depth still follows the measured taper profile. Irregular holds keep the measured envelope (keyhole upper pocket, closed-crimp wedge, elongated top jug). Measured footprints are fit with a low-degree Part.BSplineCurve.approximate (C2, DegMax=5, 0.8 mm), discretized at 0.05 mm, resampled to 120 points. Region surfaces are reoriented from the recess floor normal so both halves face the front (mirroring had flipped one half; single-sided material culled it as white holes in the app). Back is flat (protrusions carry no back-plane floor).
